subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus focused positive/negative SDK-error coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI stale encrypted_content rotation, or require an organic after-fix Grok recovery capture before merge?
rationale: ClawSweeper's default external-PR gate requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the author credibly explains that the exact code-less provider error depends on xAI key/model rotation and cannot be forced on demand without exercising a different coded error path.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the real pre-fix outage logs plus the narrow predicate tests as enough for this provider-owned rotation failure, then merge after exact-head maintainer review and CI.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs

options.title: Replace with broader recovery work
